notes: Median surface over seeded 3x3 families (games_per_cell=5 — a coarse first map, no per-cell claims; FDR control would be needed for any). Correctness leg: the alpha=0 row must read ~0 on R and EPR at every lambda. CAVEAT (red-team O-2): in cells with rho >= 1 the resolvent (I - SB) is near-singular, so R medians there are magnitude-unreliable (direction/order only); supercritical_frac marks those cells. Wedge onset stated precisely: median game crosses rho = 1 from alpha = 0.5 (lambda >= 8.5); a 0.2 fraction of games crosses already at alpha = 0.4. Full surface in phase_map_surface.json.
